slides.headline: AI agents that never forget
slides.say: A free, open-source GitHub project that lets you give AI agents persistent memory that lasts.

slides.headline: Gives AI agents lasting memory
slides.body: Remembers preferences and history across conversations automatically
slides.say: This tool gives AI agents a memory layer remembering your preferences across conversations, making the AI more helpful over time.

slides.headline: 69,270 GitHub stars
